sources_considered.why: Original September 2023 version documents controlled generalization failures.
Original contemporary evaluation reports both successful transfer and substantial degradation.

evidence_items.explanation: Experiments with fictitious facts demonstrate failures to learn reversed relations; celebrity questions also expose asymmetric performance. These support concerns about generalization, but neither establish an October-wide performance estimate nor settle understanding.

Across 11 tasks, models achieved nontrivial performance on counterfactual variants while consistently performing worse than under default conditions. This supports a reliability concern while cautioning against interpreting failures as proof that models possess no transferable reasoning skills.

unresolved_gaps: The studies do not establish whether the systems 'really understand' their outputs.
No representative evaluation located settles dependable novel reasoning across the full population of systems at publication.
The contemporary studies are contextual evidence, not measurements explicitly dated within the October target interval.
